claim: Traditional grocery retail (mom-and-pop stores) represents 75-85% of total FMCG consumption in emerging markets and will remain dominant for the next decade.
Subsidizing FMCG prices with venture capital creates vanity GMV with near-zero long-term customer loyalty.
Branded staple FMCG gross margins are structurally thin (3% to 6%), making heavy 1P warehouse and fleet operations loss-making without high-margin ancillary revenue.
Embedded fintech and working capital financing generate significantly higher contribution margins than wholesale transaction commissions alone.
Establishing the platform as the System of Record with real-time SKU telemetry creates a high-margin enterprise data asset that FMCG manufacturers actively pay for.
